# HyperFeed Cache

The `github.com/herdworks/hyperfeed-go/cache` package caches `hyperfeed.Item` asset files, including images, videos, audio, and other enclosures.
It is distinct from the `storage` (feed metadata & item content) and `state` (subscription & scheduler status) packages.

## Goals

* Deterministic URI scheme
* Age-based retention policy
* Side-effect free reads; safe concurrent access
* Separation of concerns between Cache API and file system (`internal/filesystem`)

## Layout

* Cache files are grouped by namespace (e.g. `example.com/feed`)
* Cache files are sharded using `YYYY/MM/DD` subdirectories (in UTC)
* Cache files are keyed by `hyperfeed.Item.ID`
* Cache files names may optionally include a subpath (e.g. `images/cover.png`)
* Cache files URIs are constructed deterministically (i.e. namespace, item, and filename)
* Cache files are locked at the item level

```shell
cache/                      # root cache directory
    :namespace/             # cache namespace
        :YYYY/:MM/:DD/      # cache shards (UTC)
            :itemID/        # cache key
                :filename   # cache filename
                cache.lock  # cache lockfile (item-scoped)
```

## Cache File URIs

Cache file URIs are constructed deterministically using a `Feed`, `Item`, and cache file name.

* The cache file namespace domain is generated from the Feed URL 

  ```go
  normalization.Domain(feed.URL) // a DNS host name
  ```

* The cache file namespace feed ID is generated from the Feed URL.Path and URL.RawQuery
  
  ```go
  feedID := normalization.Identifier(normalization.Path(feed.URL)) // 40-digit hex string
  ```

* The cache file shard path is generated from an Item timestamp

  ```go
  var ts *time.Time = item.Published // use published date by default
  if !item.Updated.IsZero() { ts = item.Updated } // use updated date if available
  yyyy := fmt.Sprintf("%04d", ts.UTC().Year())
  mm := fmt.Sprintf("%02d", ts.UTC().Month())
  dd := fmt.Sprintf("%02d", ts.UTC().Day())
  shard := filepath.Join(yyyy, mm, dd)
  ```

* The cache file item ID is generated by hashing the normalized value of `Item.URL`_

  ```go
  normalization.Identifier(normalization.URL(item.URL)) // 40-digit hex string
  ```

* The cache file name is cleaned using `normalization.CleanPath()`
  
  NOTE: _Cache writers should surface a descriptive error when `CleanPath` rejects a filename so feeds with bad data can be skipped safely._
